exposure: Standard risk-stratified postpartum VTE chemoprophylaxis protocol
More selective postpartum VTE chemoprophylaxis protocol
cohort: The study included 17,489 patients who delivered at a single tertiary care center in the southeast US.
finding: A more selective risk-stratified approach to enoxaparin thromboprophylaxis for VTE was associated with decreased rates of wound hematomas without increased rates of postpartum VTE.
